w10_T4_000798: Nadia has been playing the piano for a dozen years, and she plans her practice carefully. Her old daily routine took 73 minutes, a little over an hour. She cut 14 minutes of scales and 17 minutes of sight-reading, but she added a 44-minute new piece, a 19-minute warm-up, and a 69-minute recital run-through. She then followed this new routine exactly on each of 6 days. How many minutes did Nadia practise over those 6 days in total?
w10_T4_000804: Amir collects arcade tokens. On each of 3 visits he won 217 tokens. He lost 44 tokens through a hole in his bag, and then his cousin handed him 69 tokens. The arcade is open 12 hours a day. At the prize counter every token is redeemed for 6 tickets, and Amir redeems all of his tokens. How many tickets does Amir get?
w10_T4_000806: The history shelf in the town library held 194 books at the start of the week. On Monday 151 of them were lent out to a school for a project. On Tuesday the librarian removed 7 damaged books from the shelf. On Wednesday 11 books were donated to a hospital library, and on Thursday 10 more were borrowed by readers. How many books were left on the history shelf?
w10_T4_000813: Rosa had 122 stamps in her collection, and at a market she found 7 more. The market charged 3 dollars for entry. Rosa then traded 123 of her stamps to a dealer, who replaced each stamp she still had with 2 rare stamps. Her cousin Ben, who had only 15 stamps, far fewer than Rosa started with, gave her all 15 of his. Finally Rosa bought 40 stamps at a fair. How many stamps does Rosa have now?
w10_T4_000816: Jorge's hens lay 236 eggs every week, and he saved every egg for 4 weeks. His neighbour Elena, whose small flock lays far fewer eggs than Jorge's, gave him 59 eggs, and he bought 55 more from a market. His barn has 12 nesting boxes. Jorge then sold every egg he had for 5 cents each. How many cents did Jorge receive?
w10_T4_000831: In the morning Lena counted 239 cans on the food-bank shelves and sent 20 of them to a shelter. Later that morning Marcus dropped off 55 cans, a bigger donation than the 42 cans Lena herself brought in, and both donations went on the shelves. In the afternoon a school delivered 22 more cans. The food bank is open 6 days a week. In the evening 131 cans were packed into boxes for delivery and another 76 were handed to families. How many cans were on the shelves at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000834: Theo keeps a coin jar that held 197 cents, almost two dollars. He dropped in 22 cents he found on the pavement. Then he took out 173 cents to buy a snack. Later in the week he added 78 cents, and after that another 54 cents. How many cents are in the jar now?
w10_T4_000836: A city bus left the depot with 36 passengers on board. At the first stop 3 people got on. At the second stop 23 people got off, and at the third stop 12 more got off. The route is 14 kilometres long. At the railway station 78 people got on, and at the last stop before the centre 17 more boarded. How many passengers were on the bus then?
w10_T4_000837: A bolt factory packs 140 bolts in each tray. There are 3 trays in a bin, 7 bins on a pallet, and 4 pallets in each truck. On Friday 8 full trucks leave the factory, and the whole shipment is shared equally among 5 warehouses. Ivy, who runs the Riverside warehouse, receives exactly the same number of bolts as Raj at the Hilltop warehouse. How many bolts does Ivy's warehouse receive?
w10_T4_000863: A farm's sprinkler system runs in cycles of 180 seconds, which is three minutes each. Every zone gets 4 cycles, and there are 5 zones in each field. The farm has 9 fields, and the whole system runs 2 sessions a day. If it runs like this for 7 days, how many seconds of sprinkling does the farm carry out in total?
w10_T4_000871: A bakery had 107 cookies on its cooling racks. 7 of them were broken and thrown away. The baker sold half of the remaining cookies in the morning rush. She then baked a second batch so that she had twice as many cookies as were left. Just before closing a neighbour brought over 29 cookies for the bakery to sell. How many cookies does the bakery have now?
w10_T4_000878: In the morning Kofi loaded 3 top-up cards onto his phone, and each card gave him 114 minutes of talk time. The company added a bonus of 17 minutes. In the afternoon he made a call that lasted 230 minutes, nearly four hours. In the evening he spoke to his sister Ama, who uses far more minutes each day than Kofi does, for 46 minutes. How many minutes of talk time did Kofi have left after that?
w10_T4_000880: Priya earns 35 dollars for every hour she tutors, but 8 dollars of each hour's pay is held back for tax. Each of her shifts lasts 2 hours. She works 9 shifts every week. If she keeps this up for 6 weeks, how many dollars does Priya take home?
w10_T4_000885: Maya had 42 stickers, and she was given 4 more at school. She gave 16 stickers to her brother Sam, who is a dozen years old and now has fewer stickers than Maya. At a sticker club Maya traded each of her stickers for a sheet of 4 stickers. She then handed 73 stickers to her classroom for a project. How many stickers does Maya have now?
w10_T4_000888: In the morning a food truck prepared a batch of filling that gave 69 servings, and an extra pot added 22 servings to the batch. Every batch made that day was exactly this size. During the afternoon the crew cooked 4 batches. In the evening they found 27 more servings in a cooler, but they gave 60 servings to the staff for dinner. How many servings did the truck have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000891: Dana had 211 beads for her jewellery stall. She lent 52 beads to Omar, who owns far fewer beads than Dana. A week later Omar returned all 52 beads. Dana then bought 30 more beads. She sells every bead for 8 cents. If she sells all of her beads, how many cents will Dana receive?
w10_T4_000900: A drama club raised money by selling tickets for its show. It sold 17 tickets on Monday, 23 on Tuesday, and 78 on Wednesday. The hall seats 200 people. Every ticket was sold for 9 dollars. A parent also gave the club a 22-dollar donation. How many dollars did the club raise altogether?
w10_T4_000908: Ruth's daily commute used to take 72 minutes, a little over an hour. A new bus route saved her 24 minutes, and moving to a flat closer to work saved another 24 minutes. A road detour then added 17 minutes to the trip. Finally a new express lane cut 27 minutes off. Ruth commutes 6 days every week. How many minutes does Ruth now spend commuting in a week?
w10_T4_000912: A wholesaler sells snack bars for 20 cents each. There are 6 bars in a pack, 3 packs in a box, and 5 boxes in a crate, so one crate of bars costs eighteen dollars before delivery. The wholesaler adds 17 cents to the price of each crate for delivery. A shop orders 7 crates. How many cents does the shop pay?
w10_T4_000913: Lucas collected 32 seashells on the beach in the morning and found 39 more after lunch. His sister Ines, who had gathered more shells than Lucas that day, gave him 75 of hers. In the beach contest every shell is worth 3 points. Lucas lost 9 points for shells that were cracked, and he earned a 51-point bonus for the rarest shell. How many points did Lucas score?
w10_T4_000920: In the morning a delivery driver has 65 stops on his list, but 36 of them are cancelled. Each stop that remains takes 4 minutes. In the afternoon he spends 32 minutes loading and 56 minutes on fuel and paperwork, so his whole working day is a little under three and a half hours. In the evening the manager works out that 3 drivers each did exactly the same amount of work today, and that the same happened on each of 3 days. How many minutes of work is that altogether?
w10_T4_000922: Hana earns 87 dollars for each shift at the cafe, plus a 16-dollar tip every shift. Her shifts are 5 hours long. She works 3 shifts a week, and she saves every dollar she earns for 7 weeks. Her friend Ravi earns less per shift than Hana does. At the end Hana spends 256 dollars from her savings on a laptop. How many dollars does Hana have left?
w10_T4_000931: Milo had 131 game tokens. He used 71 tokens on Saturday. He split the remaining tokens equally with his friend, keeping one of the 2 equal shares. Each token he kept is worth 9 minutes of play time. The arcade also gave Milo a bonus of 64 minutes, which is a little over an hour. How many minutes of play time does Milo have?
w10_T4_000933: A class collected 102 bottle caps for an art project. Ava brought in 35 caps and Ben brought in 39 caps, so Ben brought more caps than Ava. The teacher shared all the caps equally among the 4 tables in the room. Ava's table then used 25 caps to build a model. How many caps were left at Ava's table?
w10_T4_000937: Nell and her 2 brothers shared 63 dollars from their grandfather equally among the 3 of them. Nell then earned 35 dollars babysitting. She spent 42 dollars on shoes and 5 dollars on a bus fare, and the bus ride took half an hour, that is thirty minutes. Her aunt then doubled the money Nell had left. How many dollars does Nell have now?
